cohort: The study included 116 first-, second-, and third-level public, private, and mission/nonprofit hospitals across all 10 provinces of Zambia.
finding: The study successfully quantified nationwide perioperative healthcare capacity in Zambia, highlighting significant gaps in infrastructure, surgical capabilities for certain procedures, and financial resources across various NSOAP domains.
mod_finding: The overall ability to perform caesarean deliveries was found to be 89% across the facilities surveyed.
